modality.description: Which modality this vector represents (useful for joint-multimodal results).

embedding_option.description: TwelveLabs Marengo: which view of the segment this vector represents.

outputs.description: One or more vectors produced for this input. Single vector for text/image; multiple for segmented video/audio or joint-multimodal models that return per-modality vectors.

input_tokens.description: Token count attributed to this input, when reported by the provider.

EmbeddingTaskType.description:
Semantic task type for embedding models. Drivers map these to provider- specific values (e.g. "RETRIEVAL_QUERY" for Vertex, "search_query" for Cohere).
- "query"    — a search query to find relevant documents
- "document" — a document to be indexed and retrieved

results.description: One result item per input, in the same order as EmbeddingsOptions.inputs.

model.description: The provider model id that produced the result.

usage.description: Aggregate token usage when reported by the provider.

prompt_cached.description: Number of input tokens read from prompt cache (discounted rate).

prompt_cache_write.description: Number of input tokens written to prompt cache.

prompt_cache_write_1h.description: Of `prompt_cache_write`, the tokens written with a one-hour cache lifetime, when the provider reports it. The remainder used the default (five-minute) lifetime.

result_image.description: Of `result`, the tokens of generated images, when the provider reports them. Image output is priced separately from text output.

provider_cost_usd.description: Amount the provider reported charging for this request, in USD, when the provider returns it (e.g. OpenRouter). Absent for bring-your-own-key requests.

headersTimeout.description: Time (ms) to wait for the first response byte after the request is sent.

bodyTimeout.description: Time (ms) between body chunks once streaming has started.

HttpTimeoutOptions.description:
HTTP timeouts applied to a driver's upstream LLM-provider calls.

All values are in milliseconds. Drivers should map these onto whatever HTTP client their SDK uses; the defaults applied in `@llumiverse/core/createDriverHttpAgent` are:   - headersTimeout:   900_000   - bodyTimeout:      900_000   - connectTimeout:   60_000   - keepAliveTimeout: 300_000

The response defaults are deliberately longer than the hosting request boundary. Application-level cancellation should end user work first; driver timeouts are bounded-resource safety nets.

PromptCacheDiagnostic.description: Safe diagnostic for one provider-side explicit prompt-cache attempt. It never contains prompt contents, images, credentials, or full provider resource names.

tool_use_id.description: The tool use id if the segment is a tool response

thought_signature.description: Gemini thinking models require thought_signature to be passed back with tool results. This should be copied from the ToolUse.thought_signature when sending tool responses.

prompt_cache_schema_suffix.description: Provider-specific opt-in to put the result schema after the cached prompt prefix instead of including it in native structured-output configuration. The returned JSON is still validated against result_schema by Llumiverse.

include_original_response.description: If set to true the original response from the target LLM will be included in the response under the original_response field. This is useful for debugging and for some advanced use cases. It is ignored on streaming requests

prompt_cache_key.description: Stable identity for prompt caching. Providers with cache routing keys receive the value directly; providers with cache breakpoints use its presence to cache the stable prefix before the final dynamic block. Providers with fully implicit caching still require an identical prompt prefix.

prompt_cache_mode.description: Controls provider-side explicit caches — cache resources the driver creates and reuses (e.g. Vertex cachedContents). "auto" (default) caches the static prefix whenever prompt_cache_key is set; "off" never creates or uses a cache resource and leaves the provider payload unchanged; "required" behaves like auto but surfaces cache preparation failures instead of falling back. Implicit caching and cache breakpoints are unaffected.

prompt_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime, in seconds, of a provider-side cache resource created for this execution. Defaults to 1800 (30 minutes) and must be at least 60 seconds. Ignored by providers without an explicit cache API.

httpTimeout.description: Per-call HTTP timeouts for upstream LLM-provider calls. These override the driver's default `DriverOptions.httpTimeout` for this execution only.

output_modality.description: Deprecated: This is deprecated. Use CompletionResult.type information instead.

ToolDefinition.description:
Tool definition for LLM tool use. The input_schema uses a permissive type to support both:
- AJV's JSONSchemaType<T> for type-safe schema generation
- Plain object schemas for simpler cases

thought_signature.description: Gemini thinking models require thought_signature to be passed back with tool results. This preserves the model's reasoning state during multi-turn tool use.

ToolUse.description: A tool use instance represents a call to a tool. The id property is used to identify the tool call.
